::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Planned, from the syllabus"}
Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Pass 1: tempo, meter, phrase boundaries. Pass 2: rhythm only. Pass 3: contour and anchor pitches. Pass 4: exact pitches and expression.
> - Never skip forward. Every pass you skip gets paid for twice in debugging.
> - Mark uncertain notes with a comment convention you can grep for.
>
> **Ends with: a checklist and an event schema you will apply unchanged to every transcription.**
:::
